contributions: Systematic organization of decision-making algorithms around four sources of uncertainty: outcome, model, state, and interaction
Julia-based algorithmic implementations prioritizing interpretability over efficiency for educational purposes
Unified framework spanning planning, reinforcement learning, optimization, and supervised learning methods
Real-world applications across aerospace, autonomous vehicles, healthcare, finance, and robotics domains
limitations: The Julia implementations prioritize interpretability over computational efficiency, making them less suitable for direct industrial deployment without alternative implementations. The focus on discrete-time problems excludes continuous-time control theory. The textbook assumes prior mathematical maturity in multivariable calculus, linear algebra, and probability. Coverage is foundational rather than exhaustive, with some methodological areas only briefly mentioned.
methods: The book covers explicit programming, supervised learning (behavioral cloning), optimization-based search, model-based planning, and reinforcement learning approaches for designing agents that make decisions under uncertainty. Algorithms are implemented in Julia for human-readable expression, with simulation-based evaluation used to test decision strategies across diverse application domains.
results: The textbook structures its content around four uncertainty types (outcome, model, state, interaction) demonstrated through six application domains: aircraft collision avoidance, automated driving, breast cancer screening, financial consumption/portfolio allocation, distributed wildfire surveillance, and Mars rover autonomy. No experimental quantitative results are presented—this is an introductory textbook covering established methods from the literature.
tldr: This textbook provides a comprehensive introduction to algorithms for decision making under uncertainty, covering mathematical formulations and computational approaches across four uncertainty types with implementations in Julia.
